description: Vedanta Aluminium Limited engages in the production of metallurgical grade alumina and aluminium products. It offers metallurgical grade alumina that is used as a raw material in ceramic and glass industries; and high grade aluminium and various other products, which are supplied to secondary fabrication units. The company provides aluminium ingots, billets, bars, and wire rods under the VEDANTAL brand name. Its products are used in power, packaging, chemical, logistics, and defense industrial sectors. The company also operates an independent power plant with a capacity of 2400 megawatts.
